author: reek
body: The four-sample driver for the ocean model. It samples the surface at four chosen points and reports displacement, normal, foam coverage and shaded colour, which is enough to check that the normals come out unit length and that foam appears exactly where the horizontal displacement folds.

author: reek
body: This was the `Driver` section of `OceanModel` until that chapter had to become citable. What it prints is unchanged.
